technology_name: A METHOD AND TOOL FOR SIMULATING ROLE PLAY BASED SUPPLY CHAIN OPERATION
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
technology_type: Supply Chain Management Software / Simulation Engine
problem_solved: Standard enterprise supply chain resource planners model logistics behaviors statically, failing to capture variable human human decisions across multi-tier networks.
description: A highly responsive, network-connected logistics simulation engine executing multi-tier role-playing interfaces (retailer, wholesaler, manufacturer) built to evaluate operational demand cascades using advanced Grey Relational Analysis (GRA) mathematical models.
applications: Enterprise logistics training software suites, smart city distribution node planning, academic operations research simulation tools, and manufacturing dispatch optimization.
secondary_sector: Infrastructure, Construction & Smart Cities, Robotics, Automation & Drones
